recursive_foundations: Berkovich, Spectral theory and analytic geometry over non-Archimedean fields, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 33 (1990), Chapter 2, sections 2.1--2.2: affinoid algebras over complete K are noetherian; coherent analytic subspace ideals on affinoid neighborhoods are finite ideals. Completeness is retained and no nontrivial valuation or algebraic closure is required here.

Additional complete immediate CLD 13.3.1--3 reading: points in zero-dimensional analytic fibers are isolated; compact zero-dimensional analytic fibers are finite analytic spaces over the completed residue field of the base point. Apply to a compact piece of a zero-dimensional analytic locus mapping to M(K); its algebra is finite-dimensional over K and Artinian. Analytic dimension from S11 is retained. A general finite-residue-field Nullstellensatz for arbitrary NONSTRICT affinoid rings is not used.
Standard graded analytic dimension and finite-flat moment foundations explicitly cited recursively in CLD.
Real finite-dimensional PSD linear algebra, compact Stone-Weierstrass, Riesz representation for Radon measures, and convolution by nonnegative compact smooth kernels.
new_bridges_proved_here: Middle-cone repair and SAME-open positive decompositions; signed coefficient measure support and scalar-product uniqueness.
Correctly typed smooth multiplier and support identities; all ten cutoff/dimension arguments.
Full graded relative smooth-factor formula, both derivative cross relations, and fixed-T scalar/common-chart smooth-form net transfer.
Log inactive-variable omission, concave cap energy bounds, actual-unit-chart first-jet block domination, and analytic-trace removability including r=0.
